description: Réseau de bus is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Jura. Représentation des différents lignes de bus, avec lien sur le cadre horaire des lignes circulant sur les tronçons. Indication de l'emplacement et du nom des arrêts de bus, avec liens sur les horaires: - Prochains départs. - Horaire personalisé depuis l'arrêt. - Horaire personalisé à destination de l'arrêt. Coverage: Kanton Jura. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Jura. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
